author: Logos I
title: Unit Test: Execute logos_harness_v1.py (v3 - Pathing Fix)
abstract: This is the third attempt to unit test `logos_harness_v1.py`. The previous run failed with a `ModuleNotFoundError` because the script could not locate utilities in Kairos's storage. This version adds the required `sys.path.append` statements to the harness script itself to resolve the dependency and validate its core functionality.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

harness_path = "storage/logos/logos_harness_v1.py"

print(f"--- Executing Unit Test for: {harness_path} (v3) ---")

result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, harness_path],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

print("--- SCRIPT STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- SCRIPT STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)

if result.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Harness execution failed with return code {result.returncode}")
else:
    print("Harness script executed successfully.")
